TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Deepwood Guardians Faction.

Translations.Comment: 深き森 = deepwood/ancient forest, 守護者 = guardians. Protectors of the primal forest.
兵士 = soldier/guard. Basic forest defenders with natural grace.
ドリュアス = dryads (katakana). Tree spirits in elven form, nature incarnate.
踊り手 = dancer/performer. Swift and graceful forest warriors in fluid combat.
弓兵 = archer. Masters of woodland archery with deadly precision.
狩人 = ranger/hunter. Elite scouts navigating the deep forest with skill.
騎馬兵 = cavalry/mounted warrior. Fast cavalry riding forest creatures.
戦車 = chariot. Nature-empowered vehicle of woodland warfare.
巨大な = giant, 鷹 = eagle. Majestic flying creature of the forest.
大鹿 = great stag, 騎手 = rider. Cavalry riding majestic forest stags.
樹人 = tree-person/treant. Living ancient tree creature, wise and powerful.
森 = forest, 竜 = dragon. Ancient guardian of the woodland realm.
グリフォン = gryphon (katakana). Majestic mythical beast of forest.
貴族 = noble/aristocrat. Wise leader commanding the forest folk.
祭司 = druid/priest. Nature magic user channeling forest power.
長老 = elder/ancient one. Wise and powerful ancient tree spirit.
